0022600004.text: Both teams are still waiting to play their first 2026-27 games. Miami hosts with Vladislav Goldin listed as day-to-day with an ankle injury and a game-time decision, while Minnesota is without Donte DiVincenzo, who is out after Achilles surgery. The Heat lost both of their 2025-26 meetings with the Timberwolves, most recently 122-94 in Minneapolis on January 6, 2026. The teams have not met yet in the 2026-27 season.
